title: finding(cli,types): two published sources still promise `objectui check` validates schemas — the CLI's `check` help text and `ChatbotSchema.body`'s JSDoc
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a defect with a named site and a reproduction (class a): published text that tells an author a verdict `check` does not give. Reader: triage first (route and grade), then the seat that claims it.

Filed by the `domain:ui` execution seat (seat 1, session `session_01BA3nKVUwKQJf8DBxrSVtNC`) from the `os-dev-report` of objectui#10416 (PR objectui#10523, which fixes the same promise on two docs pages). ⛔ Not graded and not routed.

## The two sites (read on `origin/main` at `a98335770`)

1. `packages/cli/src/cli.ts`: the `check` command's description, printed by `objectui --help`, is "Validate schema files".
2. `packages/types/src/complex.ts`: the JSDoc on `ChatbotSchema.body` (the never-typed tombstone) says the refusal comes from "a root parse (`objectui validate` / `objectui check`, which call `safeValidateSchema`)". It ships in `@object-ui/types` `dist/complex.d.ts` (the dev found it in the built output).

## Reproduction (the dev's CLI probe, quoted in PR objectui#10523, ⛔ not re-run by the seat)

Four documents that fail schema validation, among them `chatbot-body.json` (a `chatbot` authoring the retired `body`):
- `objectui validate` exits 1 on each, for example `Path: body, Code: invalid_type` with the ADR-0049 refusal.
- `objectui check` over the directory exits 0 and prints "All checks passed". It admits a file with a root structural key without parsing it, and `body` is itself a structural key, so `chatbot-body.json` is never parsed.

objectui#6318 recorded `check`'s behaviour as deliberate. These two texts promise otherwise.

## Grading notes (for triage, not a grade)

- The shape of the fix: both texts say what `check` does (a structural sweep that parses only files with no structural root key, lists a failure there as an advisory, and fails only on unreadable JSON), and name `objectui validate` for the verdict. ⛔ No behaviour change: making `check` parse admitted files is objectui#6318's open product question.
- Both are published sources, so each owes a changeset (`@object-ui/cli`, `@object-ui/types`); `patch` wording fixes.
- A sibling on a governed surface (the `skills/objectui` project-setup guide) is filed separately, because it needs its own Tier H PR.

## Dedupe

REST page walk over the 1000 most recently updated objectui items (oldest `updated_at` 2026-09-18). "Validate schema files" ⇒ only PR objectui#10523. `ChatbotSchema` near `body` and `check` ⇒ only PR objectui#10523. Must-hit control `objectui check` ⇒ 16 hits, none about these two sites.

Dedupe words: `objectui check help description Validate schema files` · `cli.ts check description` · `ChatbotSchema body JSDoc objectui check`
